list.title: Turn off an unused light
list.why: Lighting is one of the easiest loads to cut at home.

list.title: Unplug an idle charger
list.why: Plugged-in chargers keep sipping power even when nothing is attached.

list.title: Use a fan instead of AC for an hour
list.why: A ceiling fan uses a small fraction of the electricity of an air conditioner.

list.title: Air-dry clothes instead of using a dryer
list.why: Dryers are among the hungriest appliances in a home.

list.title: Turn off all standby devices before bed, every night this week
list.why: Standby power can be 5–10% of a household’s electricity use.

list.title: Turn off the tap while brushing
list.why: A running tap wastes around 6 litres a minute.

list.title: Reuse water for plants
list.why: Rinse water from vegetables is perfect for a thirsty plant.

list.title: Take a shorter shower
list.why: Cutting two minutes saves buckets of water and the energy to heat it.

list.title: Run the washing machine only when full
list.why: Half loads use almost as much water and power as full ones.

list.title: Fix or report a dripping tap
list.why: One dripping tap can leak thousands of litres a year.

list.title: Refuse a plastic bag
list.why: Single-use bags are among the most common items found on beaches.

list.title: Carry a reusable bottle
list.why: One bottle can replace hundreds of plastic ones a year.

list.title: Segregate wet and dry waste
list.why: Sorted waste is far more likely to be recycled or composted.

list.title: Recycle a paper or cardboard item
list.why: Recycled paper uses much less water and energy than new paper.

list.title: Compost food scraps for a week
list.why: Food in landfill releases methane; compost feeds soil instead.

list.title: Walk or cycle instead of a short car ride
list.why: Short trips are where cars are least efficient and most polluting.

list.title: Combine errands into one trip
list.why: Fewer cold starts means far less fuel burnt.

list.title: Carpool instead of a solo trip
list.why: Two people in one car halves the emissions per person.

list.title: Use public transport for a trip
list.why: A full bus takes dozens of cars off the road.

list.title: Check tyre pressure with a parent
list.why: Properly inflated tyres improve mileage and reduce emissions.

list.title: Finish a plate with no food waste
list.why: About a third of all food produced is never eaten.

list.title: Avoid a single-use food container
list.why: Takeaway boxes are used for minutes and last for centuries.

list.title: Eat a plant-based meal
list.why: Plant-based meals typically have a much lower carbon footprint.

list.title: Pack a reusable lunch box
list.why: Skips the wrappers, foil and plastic that come with packed food.

list.title: Buy a local or seasonal item
list.why: Seasonal produce travels less and needs less cold storage.

list.title: Share one sustainability fact
list.why: Ideas spread through friends faster than through ads.

list.title: Bring your own bag while shopping
list.why: Visible habits nudge the people around you.

list.title: Plant or water a plant
list.why: Green space cools cities and feeds birds and bees.

list.title: Start a sustainability conversation at home
list.why: Household decisions on power, water and food add up.

list.title: Join a local clean-up
list.why: Litter picked up today never reaches a river or the sea.
